stories.title: Iredell-Statesville Schools board holding emergency meeting as Coddle Creek mold concerns continue
stories.summary: The Iredell-Statesville school board is holding an emergency meeting as Coddle Creek Elementary remains closed for mold cleanup. No public comment will be taken.

stories.title: Need help paying your heating bill? Mecklenburg County has programs for that
stories.summary: Mecklenburg County offers help with winter heating bills. Learn who qualifies for LIEAP payments of up to $500 and when applications open.

stories.title: Clear skies and mild temperatures delight Charlotte metro with fall-like conditions
stories.summary: Enjoy a stretch of late-fall weather across the Piedmont as high pressure brings clear skies, crisp air, and mild temperatures into the weekend.

stories.title: 1 dead after car fire in west Charlotte
stories.summary: MEDIC confirmed the fire happened in the 2600 block of Ashley Road just before 1 a.m. Thursday.

stories.title: Mecklenburg County, Discovery place deal to open Freedom Park nature museum
stories.summary: Mecklenburg County commissioners approved a deal that resolves a $13.7M debt and paves the way for the Freedom Park nature museum to open in spring 2027.

stories.title: Man found dead at east Charlotte nature preserve, homicide investigation underway
stories.summary: The man was found dead in the area of the Evergreen Nature Preserve.

stories.title: Duke Energy customers will see higher bills starting in January after rate increases approved
stories.summary: North Carolina regulators approved Duke Energy rate increases starting Jan. 1, 2027. Here's how much more customers can expect to pay each month.

stories.title: NCDOT outlines I-85 widening timeline, holiday lane closure limits.
stories.summary: Drivers will see work at Gaston County exits before new lanes are added. A separate project near Charlotte Douglas has already closed Sam Wilson Road at I-85.

stories.title: Kannapolis fire that killed 12-year-old ruled accidental
stories.summary: The fire happened at a home on Polo Avenue on Nov. 14.

stories.title: New South Carolina law allows UTV owners to drive side-by-sides on some public roads
stories.summary: Starting November 18th UTV owners will be allowed to drive their vehicles on certain South Carolina roads.

stories.title: 2.4 magnitude earthquake shakes Rowan County late Tuesday night
stories.summary: Residents across several counties north of Charlotte reported hearing a loud boom or feeling shaking just after 11 p.m. Brad Panovich confirmed it was an earthquake.

stories.title: NC Board of Education issues expectations to CMS amid leadership concerns
stories.summary: State leaders say in the letter that these actions will "strengthen governance functions and position the district for long-term success."
